name: Programming and backend engineering
role_distribution: AI backend; Agent app; full-stack; framework; FDE
context_summary: Build deployable services, APIs, business integrations, async/runtime logic and maintainable production code; language choice varies, with Python common and Java/Go/C++ repeatedly accepted
caveat: No single language is universal; do not abandon Java solely because Python appears often

name: Tool calling and API integration
role_distribution: Agent app; framework; AI backend; enterprise integration
context_summary: Connect models to real capabilities and business systems through Tool/API/Function Calling, schemas and controlled execution
caveat: Framework syntax matters less than reliable tool contracts and business-side validation

name: Planning workflow state and context
context_summary: Decompose multi-step work, route next actions, retain task state/context, stop/retry safely and make long tasks inspectable
caveat: Reflection and long-term memory are not automatically required; use only where scenario evidence justifies them

name: RAG retrieval and knowledge systems
role_distribution: Agent app; LLM app; enterprise integration
context_summary: Ground non-structured domain knowledge, enterprise documents and specialist decision context
caveat: High frequency does not justify vectorizing structured business facts; SQL/API remains preferable for authoritative state

name: Evaluation testing and observability
role_distribution: Agent app; eval/quality; platform; AI backend
context_summary: Measure task success and failures, evaluate tool/answer behavior, trace runs, regress versions, and expose cost/latency/quality
caveat: Named eval platforms are optional; versioned cases and reproducible metrics are the underlying capability

name: Business-system integration and enterprise state
role_distribution: AI app; enterprise software; FDE; full-stack
context_summary: Translate business requirements into APIs/tools and connect Agent actions to ERP/MES/OA/WMS/email/financial/R&D or other deterministic systems
caveat: A local contract-realistic business system is acceptable when production enterprise credentials are unavailable

name: Reliability performance and failure handling
context_summary: Handle latency, concurrency, exceptions, retries, stability, failure analysis and operational quality beyond a happy-path demo
caveat: Do not over-engineer distributed infrastructure before proving the thin vertical slice

name: Security permissions approval and safe writes
context_summary: Control permissions, Prompt Injection/unsafe behavior, write boundaries and auditability for enterprise actions
caveat: Frequency is lower than Tool/RAG, but risk impact makes it mandatory when the project changes business state

name: MCP A2A and standardized tool protocols
context_summary: Standardize tool/context interoperability and connect Agent runtimes to existing capabilities
caveat: Often appears as one implementation option or bonus; prove HTTP/tool contracts first instead of making MCP the project purpose

name: Multi-Agent collaboration
context_summary: Coordinate specialized agents or distributed task decomposition in scenarios where one stateful workflow is insufficient
caveat: High visibility but rarely a universal hard requirement; default reject unless a single-agent workflow demonstrably fails

name: Frontend and human interaction
context_summary: Expose task progress, allow human intervention and make enterprise workflows usable
caveat: A minimal UI is enough for interview evidence; decorative dashboards should not displace core Agent engineering

name: Containers cloud and cluster orchestration
context_summary: Deploy and operate AI services reproducibly; platform roles may require deeper cloud-native knowledge
caveat: Docker is useful; Kubernetes is not a default project Must for a single-person 6–8 week build

name: Post-training RL and model fine-tuning
context_summary: Optional optimization or adjacent model work rather than the dominant task in application-engineering roles
caveat: Pure RLHF/SFT/pretraining roles were deliberately excluded; do not turn an application project into a training project

name: AI coding and AI-native development workflow
context_summary: Use coding agents/tools to accelerate implementation, testing and software workflows while retaining design ownership
caveat: Using AI coding tools is not a substitute for understanding and reproducing core mechanisms
